content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Amarillo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's formal prerequisites—typically a combination of a four-year degree and documented hours leading projects, or equivalent alternatives. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify your qualifications match PMI's standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Amarillo cohorts deliver the PMI-required formal education in real time, with interactive instruction and Q&A sessions. Upon completion, you'll receive your Certificate of Completion—the formal proof PMI requires before you submit your application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your Certificate of Completion from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your eligibility, typically within one to two weeks, before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance to reinforce your training. Once PMI approves your application, schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in Amarillo or online. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you must renew every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or published contributions to the field. Granite PM Academy offers PMP renewal courses and resources to help you stay current and keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
